paragraphs.text:
You write a reasonable bid for the pair of clay cylinders and 
place it in the box. Shortly after you do so, Mr. Warren clears 
the box and begins checking the bids.

• Make an Appraise or Credit Rating roll, both at Hard difficulty 
(success only at equal to or below half of the skill’s value): if you 
succeed, go to 38; if you fail, go to 73.
